metadata.question: Was there an active fire present in Monte Pisano in Northern Italy between February 24, 2019 and February 26, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Monte Pisano, Northern Italy (approximately 43.7°N, 10.4°E) - Date range: February 24-26, 2019 - Dataset: MODIS Thermal Anomalies (MOD14A1 or MCD14ML) or Sentinel-2 for burn/fire detection - Alternative: FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) data via MODIS 2. Masking strategy: - Fire detection should use thermal bands or fire products directly - If using Sentinel-2, check for burn scars (high NIR, low SWIR) or use FIRMS data - MODIS thermal anomaly detection is ideal for this short timeframe 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Valid Zero (B - No fire): Images exist, pixels are valid, but no fire pixels detected (confidence = 0 or fire mask = 0) - Null (C3): Fire data is corrupt or missing - No data (C1): No imagery available for the date range - No valid pixels (C2): All pixels masked out - Answer A: Fire detected (confidence > 0, fire pixels present) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Monte Pisano region, Northern Italy const montePisano = ee.Geometry.Point([10.4, 43.7]).buffer(5000); // ~5km buffer // Define date range: Feb 24-26, 2019 const startDate = '2019-02-24'; const endDate = '2019-02-27'; // Load MODIS Thermal Anomalies dataset const modisTA = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(montePisano); const size = modisTA.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Thermal Anomalies images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log('No MODIS data available for this date range.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Process each image and check for fire detections // Fire mask: 1 = fire detected, confidence > 0 const fireDetected = modisTA.map(function(img) { const fireMask = img.select('FireMask'); const confidence = img.select('MaxFRP'); // Maximum Fire Radiative Power return img.set('firePixels', fireMask.eq(1).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: montePisano, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask')); }); const results = fireDetected.aggregate_array('firePixels').getInfo(); console.log(`Fire pixels per image: ${results}`); // Check if any fire pixels detected const totalFirePixels = results.reduce((a, b) => a + (b || 0), 0); console.log(`Total fire pixels detected: ${totalFirePixels}`); // Also get high confidence fire detections const confidenceCheck = modisTA.select('MaxFRP') .reduce(ee.Reducer.max()) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: montePisano, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); console.log(`Max Fire Radiative Power detected: ${confidenceCheck}`); if (totalFirePixels > 0 || (confidenceCheck && confidenceCheck.MaxFRP > 0)) { console.log('Active fire detected in Monte Pisano (Feb 24-26, 2019)'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No active fire detected in Monte Pisano (Feb 24-26, 2019)'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
